title: This Filmmaker Exposed Benjamin Netanyahu. Now, He’s Taking On Elon Musk
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
If you're a fan of **Mehdi** , you know he's been
[critical](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mwCOsg7O_w4) of Elon Musk for
years.

So when he heard that **Alex Gibney** , the award-winning documentarian who
[took on Benjamin Netanyahu](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-
news/alex-gibney-benjamin-netanyahu-doc-tiff-1236002095/), was making a film
exposing the world's richest man, he was very intrigued.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

After spending three years putting together a nearly four-hour film, Gibney
tells Mehdi that he sees Musk as **" power without purpose… We think of him as
this futuristic tech titan, but he's really the classic American trickster or
confidence man."**

If you want to get to the bottom of how exactly Elon Musk became so powerful,
and why Gibney believes he may be the most dangerous man on Earth, this is a
must-watch conversation.

In this 45-minute interview, the two discuss:

  * The legal threats Musk's lawyer made against Gibney and his team

  * How Musk was able to build his "genius" persona

  * The U.S. government's complicity in the rise Elon Musk

  * Musk's obsession with repopulation and a looming "civil war"

  * Why Musk became involved in right-wing politics

  * Musk and Trump's volatile relationship, which Gibney calls a **" marriage of convenience"**

  * And whether Elon Musk rigged the 2024 presidential election.
